decision: Rights decision of 2026-10-06 (rights/RIGHTS_DECISION_2026-10-06.md, section 7.1 and appendix A) as applied by the cautious-counsel review of the same day (rights/SKEPTIC_REVIEW_2026-10-06.md, findings F2 and F3 and its count audit): serve a recording only if the decision keeps it, the review names no hold trigger for it, and its MP3 carries no embedded licence notice naming NC, ND or SA

reasons.SERVE: In the decision's keep set (A.16), clear of the review's hold triggers, and the MP3 carries no embedded licence notice naming NC, ND or SA
reasons.A.1: Decision A.1: remove now; audio bound to the wrong row, or bytes identical to a row under another licence
reasons.A.2: Decision A.2: created before 2013-11-25 but labelled CC BY 4.0, with no 2011-13 evidence of BY
reasons.A.3: Decision A.3: no longer listed in FMA's own sitemap
reasons.A.4: Decision A.4: the Internet Archive's copy of the album records BY-NC or the FMA licence; hand check
reasons.A.5: Decision A.5: the licensor's FMA page shows CC BY-NC today
reasons.A.6: Decision A.6: CC0 applied by a radio-station curator to third-party records; disabled
reasons.A.7: Decision A.7: contest entry on a pre-existing composition
reasons.A.8: Decision A.8: titles that name songs which may be third-party compositions
reasons.A.9: Decision A.9: titles that indicate a cover, remix, feature or 'vs'; manual check
reasons.A.10: Decision A.10: a WFMU-recorded live session; manual check
reasons.A.11: Decision A.11: a third-party publisher or another composer named in the supplied notices
reasons.A.12: Decision A.12: CC0 uploaded through a curator folder rather than the artist's own account; authority check
reasons.A.13: Decision A.13: CC0 in the ccCommunity and no_curator folders, whose artist-upload status no note establishes
reasons.A.14: Decision A.14: supplied notes describe samples or fragments of other material; manual check
reasons.A.15: Decision A.15: a featured performer or a third-party edit in the title or artist field; manual check
reasons.R.COLLAGE: Album notes list third-party recordings, film and documentary audio and recited texts as the source (Jarrod Fowler, 'Percussion' As Percussion: Chuck Berry, the Rolling Stones, Lennon/Ono, a Ken Burns documentary, Bergman and Kubrick films) (decision A.14 / P5)
reasons.R.FEATURED: A featured performer (ft.) in the title or artist field; A.15 held an album-mate (decision A.15)
reasons.R.PRODUCER: A third-party beat producer named in the title ('Prod. ...') (decision P5 (another composer))
reasons.R.REMIX: A third-party remix: truncated title whose source URL and album notes name the remixer, or a collection of another artist's remixes (decision A.9 / A.14 / P5)
reasons.R.COMPOSER: Performances of another composer's protected work (Illinois Brass Band: Denis Wright and others; Pizzetti, Messa di Requiem, protected in Italy) (decision P5 (another composer), section 3.2)
reasons.R.NOTICE: Supplied notes add a non-existent 'NAD' term and forbid remixing or reuse without permission (decision P5 (contradicting notice))
reasons.R.VERSION: Supplied notes state CC BY 3.0 while the row is labelled CC BY 4.0 (decision P5 (one exact licence per row))
reasons.R.SAMPLES: Supplied notes say the album uses Prelinger film and freesound samples (decision A.14)
reasons.TAG.NC: The MP3 carries an FMA-written licence notice naming NonCommercial terms; held until a dated Wayback or Internet Archive check clears it (review F2)
reasons.TAG.ND: The MP3 carries an FMA-written licence notice naming NoDerivatives terms; held until a dated Wayback or Internet Archive check clears it (review F2)
reasons.TAG.SA: The MP3 carries an FMA-written licence notice naming ShareAlike terms; held until a dated Wayback or Internet Archive check clears it (review F2)
